title: The Lighthouse
description: A light in the dark. A ship with no signal. Your first message could bring them home.
briefing: Courier, this is Mara. The Meridian is drifting toward the rocks. Wake the old lighthouse. Send the message. I'll be right here.
text: signal the keeper light the lamp the coast is dark but we are here hold your course keep the beacon to port the light is on you are not alone

title: Home Frequency
description: Calibrate the field terminal on its home frequency.
briefing: Tick here. Before we reach the next station, let's make sure those fingers know where home is. Just the home row. Take your time.
text: a sad lass asks dad a lad adds a flask a lass adds a salad dad asks a lad a flask falls a lad adds a salad a lass asks dad

title: Through the Static
description: Piece together a broken transmission from the open sea.
briefing: There. Between the static. Someone is still broadcasting from the weather station. Repeat the signal before we lose it.
text: this is station seven calling the coast we have lost the main relay heavy seas are moving east send a light across the water tell the keeper we are still here keep this channel open

title: The Keeper's Letter
description: Restore a lost letter, left beside the brass terminal.
briefing: The keeper left a note. The ink has faded, but the words still matter. Restore it, Courier. Some messages deserve to arrive.
text: if you find this letter the lamp is yours now i kept it burning through the winter not because i knew a ship was coming but because someone might be out there looking for a light

title: A Narrow Passage
description: Guide a fishing boat through a channel of submerged rocks.
briefing: A smaller boat is taking the passage. Every word must be clear. Too much static and they will turn toward the reef. Slow hands. Clean signal.
text: small vessel turn west keep clear of the reef follow the white marker reduce speed now hold steady through the channel the water is shallow keep your light in sight you are almost through

title: Storm Warning
description: Get the warning out before the storm takes the signal.
briefing: The front is moving faster than we thought. We have one chance to warn the fleet. Find your rhythm. Let the words carry you.
text: storm warning for all vessels return to sheltered water the eastern channel is closed strong winds are moving inland seek the harbor follow the beacon do not stop for cargo bring everyone home

title: The Last Relay
description: Bring the coastal network back to life, station by station.
briefing: One relay left. When this message reaches the next station, the coast will have a voice again. You did that. Now finish the connection.
text: coastal relay online send confirmation to the northern station the keeper has restored the beacon repeat the light is burning pass this message to every station on the shore the silence ends with us

title: The Wreck of the Meridian
description: Three distress calls. One terminal. Bring the fleet home.
briefing: The Meridian is breaking apart. Two rescue boats are coming in blind. Send each instruction in order. Whatever happens, keep that light burning.
text: meridian hold your position rescue boats are coming cutter one approach from the west cutter two keep clear of the stern lower the lifeboats secure the line take the children first the beacon will guide you home all vessels report safe the coast has a signal again

title: Above the Clouds
description: Leave the coast behind. Find the weather station above the cloud line.
briefing: The northern station is on the far side of this mountain. Plant your feet. Check the rope. The path goes up from here.
text: reach for the ridge grip the rope plant your feet breathe with the wind take another step the clouds are below you now keep your eyes on the summit the way is steep but the line is strong

title: Thin Air
description: Set a steady pace as the air grows thin.
briefing: Less oxygen up here. Short movements. Steady breathing. Let the rhythm do the work.
text: breathe reach hold pull rest keep the rope tight test the ice before you move find a steady rhythm your guide is just ahead the ridge is within reach keep going one step at a time

title: Ice Wall
description: Forty metres of ice. Every word is a handhold.
briefing: Storm front in eight minutes. The wall is forty metres. One grip at a time, Courier.
text: grip the ice reach higher hold the line kick into the wall pull your weight find the next hold breathe keep moving the ice is strong test the ridge reach for the rope the summit is close

title: Whiteout
description: Follow a radio voice through a world gone white.
briefing: You won't see the next flag. Listen to me instead. Three steps forward. Trust the rope.
text: follow the rope through the white keep your weight low the wind will pass the next marker is ahead turn toward the ridge wait for the gust to settle then move we are still on the same line

title: The Sheltered Path
description: Traverse a narrow ledge above the valley.
briefing: The direct route is gone. We take the ledge. Quiet steps, clean holds. We have time.
text: take the sheltered path traverse the ledge slowly keep three points on the rock check the anchor before you move share the weight across the rope step around the loose stone the shelter is ahead

title: A Note in the Snow
description: Restore the words of a courier who took this path before you.
briefing: Someone left a field book in the shelter. Read it. We aren't the first to climb this mountain for a signal.
text: we thought the mountain was silent until we stopped to listen the wind carries every voice that came before us i leave this note for whoever follows there is a way through keep a light for the next traveler

title: Summit Station
description: Reconnect the weather station at the top of the world.
briefing: There it is. Half buried, still standing. Warm up that terminal. Let's see who is listening.
text: summit station calling the coast we have reached the relay antenna alignment complete power restored to the northern grid send a weather report to the valley the mountain has a voice again we are coming home

title: The Avalanche
description: The mountain is moving. Outrun the white.
briefing: The shelf is breaking. No time to look back. Follow my voice. Find your rhythm. Move.
text: move toward the ridge keep the line tight the snow is breaking reach for the rock pull yourself clear keep moving do not stop the shelter is below cross the ice bridge follow the markers jump the gap hold the rope the door is open we made it the signal is safe
